topics_index.title: Topics
topics_index.locked_description: Upgrade your plan to access topic analysis and automatically detect and categorize conversation topics.
topics_index.disabled_description: Turn it on to automatically detect and group what your visitors ask about across conversations.
topics_index.blocked_reason: Chat log is off, so there's nothing to analyze. Turn it on in Setup → Settings to start collecting topics.
topics_index.suggested_description: Emerging themes from recent conversations that aren't in your topics yet. Add one to start tracking it.
topics_index.manage_description: Add or remove topics for this agent. Topics help categorize conversations.
topics_index.info_description: Learn how topics help organize and analyze your conversations
topics_index.info_overview: Topics are categories that help you understand what your users are talking about. Each conversation is automatically assigned one or more topics based on its content.
topics_index.info_how_1: Conversations are analyzed and categorized into topics
topics_index.info_how_2: You can customize which topics are available for your agent
topics_index.info_how_3: Topics help you identify trends and common issues
topics_index.info_how_4: A conversation can belong to several topics
topics_index.info_example_1: Technical Support: Users asking for help with bugs or errors
topics_index.info_example_2: Billing & Payments: Questions about invoices, refunds, subscriptions
topics_index.info_example_3: Product Information: Inquiries about features and specifications
topics_index.info_benefits_1: Track which topics are most popular
topics_index.info_benefits_2: Identify areas that need more attention
topics_index.dismiss_dialog_description: "{label}" won't be suggested again. You can still create it manually later.
